teaser.text: Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation (SMIC) is a factory-for-hire that turns other companies’ chip designs into physical chips. Its business is a capital-heavy exchange: customers pay for qualified wafer capacity and related engineering, while SMIC pays for factories, equipment, materials and people long before those assets earn revenue.

stock.title: SMIC stock forecast
stock.meta_description: SMIC's stock forecast weighs bear, base and bull cases against demand, margins, capacity returns and cash generation.
stock.opening: SMIC's weighted forecast is HK$63.78 in October 2027, rising to HK$74.23 in October 2029. It hinges on whether SMIC can turn factory expansion into cash returns.
stock.closing: The full SMIC memo also answers how SMIC's business works, who its rivals are, how management allocates capital, and which risks could change the outcome.

blocks.heading: Where could SMIC's shares be by 2029?

paragraphs.text: The weighted price is HK$63.78 in October 2027. It rises to HK$68.70 in October 2028 and HK$74.23 in October 2029. Including dividends, the returns are 17% and 27% in the first two periods. The 2029 return is 37% from today’s HK$54.30.
At October 2029, the bear case is HK$24.46. The bull case is HK$153.28. The probabilities are 30%, 50% and 20% for bear, base and bull.

blocks.heading: What has to go right or wrong for SMIC's forecast?

paragraphs.text: Base revenue rises from $12,800 million to $14,000 million. It reaches $15,000 million thereafter, while margins move from 56% to 57.5%. Q2 shipments rose 14.4% sequentially, selling prices rose 5.7% and utilization reached 93.7%. These facts support growth, but capacity contributes only after qualification and production. The bear case falls to $5,616 million as pull-ins reverse and margins reach 48%. The bull case reaches $10,980 million as domestic and AI-related orders, yields and mix improve.

blocks.heading: How much cash does SMIC really make?

paragraphs.text: Capital spending reached US$8,403.471 million. That left free cash flow negative US$5,226.482 million, and deducting stock compensation produced real free cash flow of negative US$5,254.521 million. Interest paid is already included in operating cash, so subtracting it again would count the same payment twice.

blocks.heading: What does an investor pay for SMIC today?

paragraphs.text: The price-to-earnings ratio, or P/E, shows how much investors pay for each dollar of annual profit. SMIC’s trailing P/E is far above its forward P/E, so the lower forward figure depends on profits arriving. That profit also needs checking: other income reached US$275.9 million in the second quarter, helped by rising investment values. Such gains can lift reported earnings without SMIC producing another wafer.

earnings.title: SMIC earnings
earnings.meta_description: SMIC's next results are due November 13, 2026. Watch pricing, shipments and customer acceptance as capacity expands.
earnings.opening: SMIC's next results are expected on November 13, 2026. Watch whether SMIC's customers accept new capacity and keep demand from being pulled forward.
earnings.closing: The full SMIC memo also covers its business, rivals, management and risks.

paragraphs.text: SMIC could reach HK$74.23 by October 2029 for a 37% return including dividends, if demand, margins, and capacity returns improve enough to produce durable shareholder cash returns. Management guided to revenue growth of 2.0%–4.0% for the quarter to September 2026. It guided to gross margin of 26.0%–28.0%. For 2026, it expects revenue growth above the industry average in its markets and capital expenditure roughly flat against the previous year.

blocks.heading: Did SMIC keep its spending promise?

paragraphs.text: Capital spending creates a second test. SMIC expected spending to be roughly flat in its February 2025 presentation, but it reached about US$8.1 billion. Depreciation then spreads the cost of factories and equipment across their useful lives, reducing reported profit even though it is not a new cash payment. SMIC warned in February 2026 that depreciation would rise 30 percent.

blocks.heading: What is SMIC's revenue and profit trend?

paragraphs.text: Second-quarter revenue reached US$3,005.588 million. Gross margin rose from 20.4% to 25.3%, while operating income rose from US$150.677 million to US$534.179 million. Higher shipments and a higher blended selling price helped, although some customers brought deliveries forward, moving revenue between periods.

Shareholder profit rose to US$479.197 million, up 261.7% year on year. But first-half designated non-recurring items contributed US$243.262 million after tax and minority interests. Removing them leaves first-half profit of US$433.383 million. Underlying profit still grew, but less dramatically than the reported figure.

blocks.heading: What should I watch in SMIC's next results?

paragraphs.text: The first checkpoint is the September-quarter result, publicly scheduled for November 13, 2026, subject to final confirmation. Investors should look for higher prices, shipments from new capacity and continued customer acceptance. Those details will distinguish lasting demand from customers ordering early to secure supply.
